200.description:
Loyalty tier descriptions returned. This endpoint does NOT wrap the response
in the standard ApiResponse envelope — the body is returned directly.

schema.description: Descriptive loyalty rules. Schema varies by merchant programme configuration.

401.description: Authentication failed. The api_key is invalid, or the JWT Bearer token is invalid or does not match the merchant context.

invalidJwt.summary: JWT token does not match merchant context

422.description: The request was well-formed but failed business rule validation (e.g. customer not found, insufficient points balance, duplicate customer).

example.data: Customer not found for the provided identifier

500.description: An unexpected server-side error occurred. Retry after a brief interval. Contact Qubriux support if the problem persists.

example.data: An internal error occurred. Please try again later.
